stem: A vaccine contains an inactivated organism. Which of the following immune-response profiles is most characteristic of this vaccine class?

options.label: A
options.text: Sustained organism replication with persistent antigen production
options.misconception: Assigns a replicating-organism mechanism to a preparation defined here as inactivated.
options.explanation: An inactivated preparation does not match a profile based on sustained organism replication; its cited adaptive response is predominantly antibody production.

options.label: B
options.text: Mostly cellular immunity with little antibody production
options.misconception: Reverses the relative humoral and cellular emphasis described for an inactivated vaccine.
options.explanation: The CDC passage places antibody production, rather than cellular immunity, at the center of the inactivated-vaccine response.

options.label: C
options.text: Immediate protection from transferred donor antibodies
options.misconception: Confuses an antigen-containing vaccine with direct transfer of an existing antibody pool.
options.explanation: The passage describes the recipient producing a predominantly antibody response to inactivated antigen; it does not describe transferred donor antibody.

options.label: D
options.text: Mostly antibody production with little cellular immunity
options.misconception: None; this is the response profile the CDC assigns to an inactivated vaccine.
options.explanation: The cited passage describes the inactivated-vaccine response as mostly antibody production with little or no cellular immunity.

options.label: E
options.text: Innate inflammation without an adaptive antibody response
options.misconception: Overlooks the antibody response explicitly described in the source passage.
options.explanation: The CDC passage specifically states that antibody production makes up most of the response, so absence of an adaptive antibody response is incompatible.

context: Learning objective: recognize the predominantly humoral profile of an inactivated vaccine. The high-yield contrast is not simply living versus nonliving antigen; it is that the cited inactivated-vaccine response is mostly antibody production, with little or no cellular immunity.
